env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd w

# An imported union with a Go decoder trials it when the holder imports the
# member package: the timestamp decodes into time.Time.
logos run ./with
stdout '^with ok 2026-01-01$'

# Without that import the member stays untriable and valid input reports
# zero matches.
! logos run ./without
stdout '0 of 2 members matched'

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/impdec

go 1.27

-- w/u/u.lgo --
package u

import "time"

type Plain struct {
	R float64
}

type MixedNode interface {
	time.Time | Plain
}

-- w/with/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"example.com/impdec/u"
)

type WithHolder struct {
	Body   u.MixedNode
	Status int = 200
}

func main() {
	var h WithHolder
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Body":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}`), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode error:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	t, ok := h.Body.(time.Time)
	if !ok {
		fmt.Printf("wrong member %T %+v\n", h.Body, h.Body)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("with ok", t.Format("2006-01-02"))
}

-- w/without/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"example.com/impdec/u"
)

type WithoutHolder struct {
	Body   u.MixedNode
	Status int = 200
}

func main() {
	var h WithoutHolder
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"Body":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}`), &h); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("decode error:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Printf("unexpected ok %T %+v\n", h.Body, h.Body)
	os.Exit(2)
}
